parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the coffee machine, typically made of durable plastic. It covers the top of the coffee bean hopper or water reservoir.
parts.Functional_description: The lid prevents dust and debris from entering the hopper or reservoir and helps maintain internal pressure and temperature during brewing.
parts.Movement_description: It can be opened or removed manually to refill coffee beans or water, and closed to seal the container.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the coffee machine, made of high-strength plastic that houses the internal components such as the water tank, pump, and heating element.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts of the coffee machine, provides structural stability, and contains the electrical and mechanical systems required for brewing coffee.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, though buttons or switches on its surface may be pressed to control the machine.
